adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`, both `updateEvent` and `deleteEvent` set the calendar ID as `externalCalendarId ? externalCalendarId : event.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.externalId === externalCalendarId)?.externalId;`. When `externalCalendarId` is falsy/undefined (the exact case the fallback branch is for), the `.find()` predicate becomes `cal.externalId === undefined`, which will almost always return `undefined`, so the selected calendar ID is not derived from `event.destinationCalendar` at all. Given the presence of `defaultCalendarId = "primary"` in `deleteEvent`, this leads to falling back to primary rather than the intended destination calendar, matching the finding’s described failure mode (event not deleted from the host’s selected calendar).
